en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a palm‑lined residential street in Southern California. On the left stands a grand neoclassical mansion with large columns and balconies, facing a manicured lawn with palm trees and other ornamental plants. The street extends into the distance with additional houses and trees along the sidewalk. Printed captions frame the image on the bottom and sides.
